what: GitHub Actions npm publish fails with E404 "Not found" on PUT to registry.npmjs.org/aide-memory. Tests pass, build succeeds, but the NPM_TOKEN in the repo secrets may not have write permission to the aide-memory package. The package exists (0.1.1 live) but was likely published from a different token or account. Manual publish works: cp package.aide-memory.json package.json && npm publish --access public && git checkout package.json.
why: Release workflow failed twice — first time tests, second time npm auth. Need to fix NPM_TOKEN permissions in aide-memory/aide-memory repo secrets, or the token may need to be regenerated with publish scope for the aide-memory package.
